rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but adds speculative details (e.g., collapse/re-expansion pattern, TE/ICM subtle critiques) that may not be firmly supported by a single still image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, endometrium, BMI, and diagnosis with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and structured, with age-related euploidy appropriately emphasized; minor tension exists between calling the embryo strong and suggesting it is not clearly elite on image alone.

Largely aligned with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF counseling, including cautious discussion of PGT-A and avoiding bed rest; minor overreach in some counseling specifics but no major guideline conflicts.
Provides clear, practical recommendations for current transfer management and future planning, including luteal support review, cavity assessment, cohort review, and selective PGT-A discussion.
